app.name: PhotoRoom: AI Photo Editor
app.description: An AI-powered photo editor that removes backgrounds, enhances images, and generates professional-quality visuals for e-commerce and social media.

verdict.one_liner: PhotoRoom edits your photos with AI, but states it may use uploaded images to train models unless you opt out, and shares data with several service providers.
verdict.summary: PhotoRoom is a capable AI photo editor that requires photo access to function. It offers an opt-out for AI model training and extensive GDPR rights, but the default use of uploaded photos for training is a notable concern. The privacy policy discloses sharing with service providers including Apple, RevenueCat, and Dub, and states that cookie data may be retained for up to 25 months with consent. Data may be transferred outside the European Economic Area.
verdict.recommendation_reason: PhotoRoom is useful for photo editing, but the privacy policy states that your uploaded images may be used to train AI models by default. Turn off AI training in your account settings and avoid uploading sensitive personal photos.

red.title: Your uploaded photos may train AI models by default
red.plain_english: PhotoRoom states that by using the service, you acknowledge that it processes and uses the images you upload to improve, train, and develop its products, services, and models, and that you can opt out at any time but this does not undo prior processing.

red.title: Cookie data kept for up to 25 months
red.plain_english: PhotoRoom states that social network and audience measurement cookies preserve your IP address and pages viewed for up to twenty-five months with your consent.

red.title: Data may be transferred outside Europe
red.plain_english: PhotoRoom states that your personal data may be transferred outside the European Economic Area under GDPR protections.

red.title: Purchase records kept for 10 years
red.plain_english: PhotoRoom states that transaction data is retained for 10 years for accounting purposes.

green.title: You can opt out of AI model training
green.plain_english: PhotoRoom states that you may opt out of having your uploaded photos used to train AI models at any time through your account settings.

green.title: Extensive GDPR rights available
green.plain_english: PhotoRoom states that people may exercise extensive controls including right of access, erasure, data portability, and options to oppose processing or revoke approval, with responses typically within one month.

green.title: Does not sell or share data under CCPA meanings
green.plain_english: PhotoRoom explicitly states that it does not 'sell' or 'share' personal data as those terms are defined by the CCPA.

green.title: No direct advertising to third parties
green.plain_english: PhotoRoom states that it does not disclose personal information to third parties for their own direct marketing purposes.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: PhotoRoom states that access to your phone's camera and photos requires your permission and lasts until withdrawn.
categories.detail: The privacy policy states that data sent by your phone's camera and photos stored on your phone are processed, and that access is only made with your permission. Device camera and photo access requires approval and lasts until withdrawn.
categories.policy_excerpt: Access to the photos is only made with your permission.
concerns: Uploaded photos may be used for AI model training by default

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention whether PhotoRoom accesses your GPS or precise location.
categories.detail: No explicit mention of GPS or precise location data collection in the privacy policy. IP address is collected for cookies and navigation, which may reveal approximate location.
concerns: IP address collected for cookies may reveal approximate location

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention whether PhotoRoom accesses your contacts or address book.
categories.detail: No reference to contacts, address book, or phonebook access in the privacy policy.

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: PhotoRoom states that it processes images you upload to improve, train, and develop its products and models, and that you may opt out of this at any time.
categories.detail: The policy explicitly states that by using PhotoRoom, you acknowledge that uploaded images may be processed to improve, train, and develop products, services, and models. You can opt out at any time, but this does not undo prior processing. API uploads are exempt.
categories.policy_excerpt: By using Photoroom, you acknowledge that Photoroom processes and uses the images you upload to improve, train and develop Photoroom's products, services and models.
concerns: Uploaded photos may be used for AI model training by default
Opt-out does not undo prior processing

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: PhotoRoom states that your personal data may be transmitted to third-party processors, including Apple and RevenueCat for refund validation, and Dub for referral programs, and that data may be transferred outside the European Economic Area.
categories.detail: The policy lists third-party processors for technical/hosting, notifications, user tracking, security incidents, etc. Specifically, browsing and interaction data are sent to Apple and RevenueCat for refund validation (kept 6 months). Email addresses are sent to Dub for referral programs with consent. Cookie providers also receive data based on banner choices. Data may be transferred outside the EEA with GDPR protections. The CCPA section states PhotoRoom does not 'sell' or 'share' data under CCPA meanings.
categories.policy_excerpt: Your Personal data may be transmitted to third-party processors involved in the provision of the Services
concerns: Data transferred outside the EEA
Multiple service providers receive user data
Referral addresses shared with Dub

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: PhotoRoom states that it collects your email, full name, and user ID for account management, and that purchase records are kept for up to 10 years.
categories.detail: Account data includes email (via GoogleAuth, FacebookAuth, or AppleAuth), full name, user ID, and optional profile photo. Login credentials remain until deletion or 2 years of dormancy, then archived for 5 years. Purchase and transaction records are retained for 10 years.
categories.policy_excerpt: Management of your account (creation, logging and unsubscription): Email address via GoogleAuth, FacebookAuth or AppleAuth (optional), Full name, User ID
concerns: Purchase records retained for 10 years
Login credentials archived for 5 years after 2 years dormancy

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: PhotoRoom states that social network and audience measurement cookies preserve your IP address and pages viewed for up to twenty-five months with your consent, and that third-party processors may provide user tracking services.
categories.detail: The policy mentions social network and audience measurement cookies that preserve IP address and pages viewed for up to 25 months with consent. It also lists 'user tracking' as a purpose for third-party processors. The policy does not explicitly state that this tracking is used for behavioral advertising.
categories.policy_excerpt: Social network and audience measurement Cookies preserve IP address, pages viewed, etc. for up to twenty-five months with consent.
concerns: Cookie data retained for 25 months
User tracking mentioned as a third-party processor purpose

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: PhotoRoom states that its services are not intended for children under 13 and that it does not knowingly collect personal data from children under 13.
categories.detail: The policy states the platform is not intended for children under 13 and that PhotoRoom does not knowingly collect personal data from children under 13. Users under 18 must have parental permission. No robust age verification mechanism is described.
categories.policy_excerpt: Our Applications and Services are not intended for and should not be used by children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 13.
concerns: No robust age verification mechanism described

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: PhotoRoom states that it collects navigation information for the duration of your session to ensure proper functioning and security.
categories.detail: The policy states that navigation information is collected under legitimate interest for providing functional services, retained for the duration of navigation. IP address is also collected via cookies for up to 25 months with consent.
categories.policy_excerpt: Ensure the proper functioning and security of the Services: Navigation information. Legitimate interest in providing a functional Services. For the duration of the navigation.
concerns: IP address logged via cookies for up to 25 months

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: PhotoRoom states that it collects data relating to devices and equipment used to provide a functional application and improve its services.
categories.detail: The policy lists 'Data relating to devices and equipment used' under proper operation of the Application, with a legal basis of legitimate interest in providing a functional Application. It does not explicitly mention unique device identifiers or device fingerprinting for advertising.
categories.policy_excerpt: Data relating to devices and equipment used. Legitimate interest in providing a functional Application/ improving our Application.
concerns: Device data collected continuously
Purpose described as functional, not explicitly for advertising

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: PhotoRoom does not collect health or biometric data.
categories.detail: The privacy policy does not mention health or biometric data collection for the core photo editing app. The CCPA section lists categories but does not state that such data is actually collected.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: PhotoRoom states that payment information is processed by a third-party payment services provider and is not kept by PhotoRoom, but purchase records are retained for 10 years.
categories.detail: Credit card or other payment methods data are not processed and kept by PhotoRoom but only by the Payment Services Provider. Transaction data (purchase history, transaction amount, user's first and last name) is retained for 10 years for accounting purposes.
categories.policy_excerpt: Please note that credit card or other payment methods data are not processed and kept by Photoroom but only by the Payment Services Provider
concerns: Purchase records retained for 10 years

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: PhotoRoom states that you may exercise rights including access, erasure, data portability, and objection, and that it typically responds within one month.
categories.detail: Users can exercise extensive GDPR rights. PhotoRoom undertakes to respond within one calendar month, or up to three months for complex requests. However, some data is retained for legal periods after deletion requests.
categories.policy_excerpt: People may exercise extensive controls, including Right of access, Right to erasure/right to be forgotten, Right to data portability, plus options to oppose processing or revoke approval.
concerns: Some data retained for legal limitation periods
Opt-out of AI training does not undo prior processing

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: PhotoRoom states that the privacy policy may be amended and that it will set up a way to inform you of changes, but does not specify the exact notification method.
categories.detail: The policy states that updates will be announced, but does not specify the mechanism (email, in-app, or website posting). There is no mention of advance notice periods or requiring active re-agreement.
concerns: Unclear notification mechanism for policy changes
No explicit advance notice period stated
